summary:
Strategic Sales & Growth Leader with cross-industry expertise in healthcare, fintech, and edtech. Known for
turning opportunities into revenue, building high-performing teams, and forging partnerships that fuel long-term
business success. A persuasive communicator and market driver who thrives on creating impact and accelerating
growth.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Revenue Growth→Revenue Generation(100%), Negotiations→Negotiation(96%), Zoho→Zoho Books(100%), fintech→Fintech(100%), healthcare→Healthcare(100%)...)

bullets: Orchestrated end-to-end sales strategy for 3 multi-speciality clinics, achieving consistent 18% MoM revenue growth.
Designed and executed 32 corporate health camps with leading companies, generating 420+ qualified patient leads.
Drove clinical sales through large-scale corporate health camps and RWA/community promotions across South Bangalore, strengthening clinic outreach.
Negotiated with property managers and community leaders to set up health satellite centres, providing doorstep healthcare benefits to entire communities.
After collaborating with the C-suite to launch Arya Health Insurance, led sales, marketing, and promotional campaigns, expanding the customer base by 22% within the first quarter.
Closed ₹1.1Cr in corporate group policies via 13 high-value negotiations in IT and manufacturing sectors.
Produced weekly market intelligence reports, positioning, and targeting strategies.
Joined as Senior Executive in the Payment Gateway segment, managing enterprise merchant relationships.
Engaged with merchants to understand business needs, educate on platform benefits, and deliver tailored services.
Negotiated agreements and analyzed merchant revenue flow to identify growth opportunities and expand business.
Collaborated with developers, identifying key benefits and creating a network that generated merchant lead referrals, boosting outreach and acquisition efficiency.
Trained and mentored new joiners on sales pitch strategies, improving team readiness and performance.
Successfully onboarded 1,200+ merchants, contributing to market expansion and digital payment adoption.
Introduced a tiered account servicing model, increasing merchant retention by 33%.
Consistently recognized as Top Performer (3 consecutive quarters) for exceeding KPIs.

jobs.company: Drove business growth by engaging with working professionals, understanding career goals
bullets: Drove business growth by engaging with working professionals, understanding career goals, and recommending online certification programs from Manipal University (MAHE Online).
Balanced individual sales contributions with managing a team of 4–6 freshers, providing training, guidance, and assistance in deal closures.
Expanded client base by 45%, while improving team productivity and target achievement through structured coaching.
Built a personal sales pipeline from scratch, consistently closing ₹6–8 lakhs monthly.
Cultivated trust-based relationships with 100+ parents, tailoring demos and consultative learning solutions.
Conducted market segmentation, optimizing demo-to-close ratios for targeted course offerings.
Mentored peers during workshops, sharing winning sales scripts and field strategies.
